description: This file is a script written in JavaScript (using ES module syntax) intended for execution in a Node.js environment. It processes documentation files to identify missing glossary entries for i18n support, analyzing changed docs via git, extracting terms, and comparing with a glossary JSON file.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for '--base' and '--head' options.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command synchronously and returns its output.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Determines the base commit or branch to compare against, using explicit input, environment variables, or default branch candidates.

methods.name: listChangedDocs
methods.description: Lists documentation files that have changed between two git commits or branches, filtered by certain filename patterns.

methods.name: loadGlossarySources
methods.description: Loads the glossary JSON file and returns a set of source terms.

methods.name: containsLatin
methods.description: Checks whether a string contains Latin alphabet characters.

methods.name: wordCount
methods.description: Counts the number of words in a string.

methods.name: unquoteScalar
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a scalar value if present.

methods.name: isGlossaryCandidate
methods.description: Determines if a term is a suitable candidate for inclusion in the glossary based on language, length, and character constraints.

methods.name: readGitFile
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a file from a specific git base or commit.

methods.name: extractTerms
methods.description: Extracts glossary-related terms and labels from documentation files based on front-matter and list item patterns.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function orchestrating the process of checking documentation differences and cross-referencing the glossary.
